provenance.source: Maximum of saturated raw frames in this library. The sensor is 14-bit, stored as 16-bit in steps of 4, so a clipped frame reaches 65532. Recorded before the camera profiles existed, in pipelines/stacking/exposure_saturation.py.
The pipeline's long-standing default for raw frames: just under the 16-bit maximum of 65535. It was never measured per camera.

Antonov 2026: the response turns non-linear above about 60,000 ADU at Gain 0 / Offset 10, before hard clipping. Recorded before the camera profiles existed, as DEFAULT_PHOTOMETRIC_LINEARITY_ADU_THRESHOLD in pipelines/shared/quality/quality_metrics.py, which nothing used.
Read off the sensitivity graph published by ZWO. Recorded before the camera profiles existed, in pipelines/spectroscopy/quantum_efficiency_curves.py.
